title: Slow to Anger, Great in Kindness
old_p1: Joel was a prophet, a helper who shared Heavenly Father’s words. Joel’s people were going through a hard, hungry time. Heavenly Father said, “Turn ye even to me with all your heart.”
“Rend your heart, and not your garments,” He said. Rend means tear. Back then, sad people tore their clothes to show it on the outside.
old_p2: But Heavenly Father wanted more than clothes. He wanted them sorry on the inside, ready to change. That is what repent means.
Joel told them why it was safe to turn back. Heavenly Father “is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness.” Gracious and merciful mean kind and forgiving.
Turning back takes courage. Tonight, feel safe knowing that when you turn around, you always turn toward the kindest heart there is.
p1: Joel told the people what Heavenly Father said. It was a hard, hungry time, and many had turned away.
Heavenly Father said, “Turn to me with all your heart.” He wanted all of them, not just a little bit.
Back then, people tore their clothes to show they were very sorry. But Heavenly Father said, “Tear your heart, and not your clothes.” He wanted them sorry inside, ready to change.
p2: Joel told them why it was safe to come back. Heavenly Father is kind and forgiving. He is slow to get angry. His kindness is very, very big.
When you do something wrong, you can turn back to Him too. You can say sorry and try again. He is happy when you come back.
